shortDescription: Reusable new membership registration detail layout.
fullDescription: Composes a membership registration review interface with a two-step sidebar, personal data header, contact and address sections, secondary membership cards, and a sticky action footer. It supports reuse for member onboarding or edit-review flows by accepting shared button, icon, and layout patterns already used across the application.

shortDescription: Reusable membership lookup and entry hub.
fullDescription: Renders the membership access hub with a branded header, two primary action cards for creating a new membership or opening pending work, and a centered search form for locating existing member records by name, phone, email, or membership number. The component can be reused for customer service and in-club membership intake flows that need a lightweight starting point before registration or profile retrieval.

shortDescription: Membership search and registration entry screen.
fullDescription: Displays a membership management entry screen with top location controls, large action cards for starting a new membership or reviewing pending processes, and a search section for finding existing member profiles before registration. The view uses the shared MembershipSearchHub component to present the branded header, action selection area, and centered lookup form.
